reviews.title: Too many bots
reviews.text:
I deleted and made new accounts to try and filter out bots as well as turning off the receive tells from the team but still most tells are from bots. 

With the content, you get the same questions over and over and when you view other people’s profiles they are all given the same questions too. 

3 language options are given: English, German and Arabic. I am registered in the English category however nearly all the accounts are Arabic and clearly bots who all have catfish photos and paid followers. 

Overall not a great app and in theory it’s good for interacting with new people but it seems like a data farming tactic where fake people ask personal questions to identify things about you for data farming purposes.

reviews.title: 1 star MAJORITY BOT QUESTIONS can’t even tell if a person
reviews.text:
I love the ease of asking someone questions with this app, but I HATE the fact that most of the questions are being asked by bots. I signed up for Tello exclusively as a place for people to send me anonymous messages. What I didn't know when signing up is they have bots asking you questions & there's no where to discern if it's a real person or a bot. And the more questions you answer, the more the bots ask you questions.
I have enough stuff to do in my life, so answering a bot question is pointless to me. Like nobody is actually reading it, they just have bots spam you questions to make you feel like people are interested in you. That's incredibly deceptive and I want nothing to do with a company that has bots running rampant for the sake of attempting to generate revenue & keep people on their app.
Hence why I'm deleting it.
I'm getting rid of Tellonym and going back to CuriousCat. I'll return if they remove bot questions entirely or limit them to once a day (and notate that it's a bot question!), but I don't see that happening anytime soon.
